title: Smoked Hash Brown Breakfast
description: A hearty breakfast dish featuring crispy smoked hash browns topped with scrambled eggs and crispy bacon.
instructions: Cut the smoked hash into 1-inch pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Bake the hash in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
In a separate bowl, scramble the eggs and set aside.
To assemble the dish, place the crispy hash on a plate, top with scrambled eggs and crumbled bacon.
Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and season with salt and pepper to taste.
